lead_raw_text:
The CeAl4Si structure crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 18 atoms per unit cell (Ce3Al12Si3) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, Ce centers with 20 neighbors, and Si centers with 9 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Al 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Al and Ce polyhedra.
